scenario: Bare-name namespace per LIMP.9.8 / LIMP.4.2 — service importing (acceptance only). `from ha import light` matches the `light` domain (first segment of any `light.*` service decl in the library); the import resolves cleanly. Per the LADP design decision, v1 service-import is acceptance-only — the call-site validator that checks kwargs against the service decl lands in a follow-up. This pin covers the import surface only.
rules_ds:
from ha import light

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

libraries.ha:
schema TurnOnAck scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service light.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String literal required
    response TurnOnAck
